arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Sutton argued Congress used commerce and Fourteenth Amendment powers to pass the ADA.
Sutton claimed government lawyers lose when they offer irrational explanations for laws.
Gottesman argued the ADA rests securely on the Commerce Clause.
Gottesman stated no state would challenge the Commerce Clause basis of the ADA.
